# Phase 164.1.1.1: LANEONLYGATES - Context

**Gathered:** 2026-09-18
**Status:** Ready for planning
**Mode:** Auto-generated (infrastructure phase — no grey areas to propose)

⚠️ **Deviation from the smart-discuss infrastructure template, stated so it is not mistaken for
drift.** That template writes `<decisions>` as a single "all at Claude's discretion" line. That
would be FALSE here and actively harmful: this phase's decisions are already LOCKED by measurement

research. `<decisions>` below therefore carries the real constraints. Nothing about this phase is
open taste.

<domain>
## Phase Boundary

`sql-tests` must stop executing gates that require a pg-lane-only fixture, and the exclusion must be
impossible to grow silently.

IN scope: the file-level exclusion mechanism, its declaration, its printing, its pinning, and the
evidence that an excluded file is still policed elsewhere.

OUT of scope: any change to what `test_prod_prober_cadence.sql` asserts; any change to the real
`pg_net` path; Phase 164.1.1 plan 06 (the live `cron.schedule`); and
`test_analytics_service_settings_and_vault_tick.sql`'s own separate, already-accepted
pre-migration-apply red, which is unrelated to this class.

</domain>

<decisions>
## Implementation Decisions

### LOCKED — the shape of the fix
- It is a **FILE-LEVEL EXCLUSION**: the file is never executed by `sql-tests` at all.
- It is **NOT an in-file skip**. WR-03 ("A PRINTED SKIP IS NOT A PASS") deliberately fails the step
  on a whole-file `RAISE NOTICE 'SKIP:'` bail-out, and that net must not be weakened.
- The artifact must **ARGUE the distinction** — "excluded from a lane it was never designed for"
  versus "runs and bails out" — rather than assume it.

### LOCKED — the floors do NOT move
- `SENTINEL_FLOOR` stays **11**, `ARMS_FLOOR` stays **213** in `ci.yml`, and the per-file derivation
  table row for `test_prod_prober_cadence.sql` (7 arms) **STAYS**.
- Reason, measured: the sentinel accounting block is static analysis of the FILE. The arm tally, the
  roster-vs-count agreement and the `n_arms` ≤ non-comment `RAISE EXCEPTION` sites check all read
  `"$f"`. **Exactly one** check in that block reads `"$out"` — `ci.yml:3515`, "declares the sentinel
  but this run never printed it".
- Therefore the exclusion skips EXECUTION plus the three `$out`-derived checks ONLY, and never the
  static accounting.
- ⛔ A plan that lowers either floor has taken the worse branch. Lowering `ARMS_FLOOR` is the exact
  signature the floor exists to catch, these 7 arms were not deleted, and all four count mirrors were
  already moved once today in v0.77.51.0 — moving them twice in one day in opposite directions is its
  own hazard. See the ORCHESTRATOR CORRECTION section of `164.1.1.1-RESEARCH.md`.

### LOCKED — the detector must not be fixture-path-based
- `test_prod_prober_cadence.sql` and `test_analytics_service_settings_and_vault_tick.sql` BOTH name a
  `scripts/pg-lane/fixtures/**` file in their `RED-UNDER-SETUP` apply lists, so *"references any
  pg-lane fixture"* is an **UNSAFE** detector — it would sweep in the vault gate, which legitimately
  runs on BOTH sides (stand-in TABLE on the lane, real `supabase_vault` VIEW on TEST) and measures
  the difference.
- The detector must key on the object the file's own ASSERTION BODY queries — `net._lane_posts`,
  unique to fixture 34.

### LOCKED — it must be impossible to grow silently
- Every excluded file is **PRINTED on every run**. A silent exclusion is the same defect class as a
  gate reporting PASS having measured nothing.
- The excluded set is pinned as **SITES, NOT A COUNT** (the B3 convention in
  `drift-check-scripts.test.ts`) — a count is blind to a one-for-one swap — and re-derived from the
  corpus by a contract test.

### LOCKED — safety
- Shared TEST carries the REAL `pg_net`. A version of this gate made to "work" there would issue
  genuine outbound HTTP from shared infrastructure every CI run. The gate is EXCLUDED, never
  accommodated onto that lane.

### Claude's Discretion
- The exact spelling of the marker comment and the exclusion's placement inside the step, provided
  the static accounting survives and every net above stays armed.

</decisions>
